title: Vector and Signal
author: Ines Pemberton
blurb: Mara Crane, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
